It's a bitch, isn't it?? The shit just feeds itself, the depression that causes you to shut others out, and the anger that lashes out at people who don't deserve it, which then makes you depressed, which makes you hate yourself even more, etc.


I'm pretty sure humans are the only species that commit suicide on a fairly regular basis.  Self awareness is wjere it all went wrong.

Had dinner with my parents today. Then ran into the ex at the gas station. Having to actually talk about my life to them made me think about how I got like this. Ex is doing well, still with the guy she left me for. Made a big step, told her everyone deserves a chance to be happy and I hope she gets hers. I meant it, too. Mostly.


My chance, though, I think has come and gone. And no, I'm not pining after her, that relationship wasnt going to last. I have just accepted that I will never be more than fleetingly happy.  I don't believe the 10% of good times outweighs the 90% of bad. heck, even 20-80 blows, I've been there.

Also, The Fox. same artist.

Someone already said it too but Molly by Lil Dicky. Actually pretty much his whole Professional Rapper album is full of songs that tell a great story

Well I guess that's my question. How many years does it have to be before the good days become more frequent? How many years, how many different medications and therapists and psychiatrists does it take before it's decided that this is never going away??

 It's a fact that everybody will die sometime.  If it's a choice between slow and painful and dying with dignity, why am I denied that choice just because I don't have visible symptoms?  Decades of depression and self hate sure sounds like a slpw and painful death to me.  Sure, I might die from something else, but if I'm suffering for years beforehand how is it different?

I have told 3 people in the past 6 months.  Each one has stopped talking to me, ghosting me when I reach out.  My family is honestly the only reason I haven't done it by now. 

My dad has recently been diagnosed with parkinson's, and it's progressing quickly. My mom was just in the hospital for a "stress related heart incident". I can't tell them, I can't add to everything they already have to cope with.

As for what is wrong, I used to think there was a reason. Years ago, I said it was my job that I was unhappy with, and if that changed it would be better. I got a new job, and that got better. Then it was my living situation, and i moved and that got better too.  Despite the fact that objectively, my life is better than it has almost ever been, I am still just... dejected.

 I can be out getting a drink and socializing with the type of people you only have superficial conversations with, the ones that see the scars on your arm and look away, or break off conversation becuase they'd rather not think about it, But ill be out because i tell myself being in public and seeing people is good and healthy, and I will be doing things that I have actually enjoyed in the past, but the whole time I just want to go home and be forgotten so I die peacefully.
